pick.name: Obsidian
pick.what: Local Markdown vault app with plugins, Web Clipper and an official CLI (since 1.12.4)
pick.why: Plain .md files on disk mean Claude Code reads and writes notes with zero glue; huge plugin ecosystem; free for commercial use
pick.free_limits: App free for all use incl. commercial; Sync $4/mo (annual) and Publish $8/mo optional

alts.name: Notion
alts.what: Cloud docs + databases with an official hosted MCP server
alts.why: Best for web-first docs shared live with clients or a team; hosted MCP (OAuth)
alts.free_limits: Free: unlimited blocks for solo workspace, 5 MB uploads, 7-day history, limited AI trial; Plus $10/member/mo

alts.name: Anytype
alts.what: Local-first, end-to-end-encrypted object/graph notes with official MCP server
alts.why: Free E2E-encrypted sync across devices; flips the choice if encrypted multi-device sync matters more than plain files
alts.free_limits: Free tier exists; exact limits not readable on pricing page
alts.license: Any Source Available License 1.0 (source-available, not OSI)

candidates.name: Obsidian
candidates.verdict: PICK: files on disk are the best Claude Code surface; free commercial use; big plugin ecosystem

candidates.name: Notion
candidates.verdict: Best for shared docs and hosted MCP; more lock-in, weak offline

candidates.name: Anytype
candidates.verdict: Free encrypted sync; source-available licence, object model harder to edit directly

candidates.name: Logseq
candidates.verdict: DB version in beta since 2026-07-13 with data-loss warnings; wait

candidates.name: AFFiNE
candidates.verdict: Active, whiteboard/doc hybrid, less mature plugin story

candidates.name: Joplin
candidates.verdict: Open source, notes in own DB/sync model, smaller plugins

candidates.name: Apple Notes / OneNote
candidates.verdict: Fine for casual use; not file-based, weak for agents

decision: Obsidian wins because a folder of Markdown is the lowest-friction thing for Claude Code to read, grep and write, and it costs $0 for commercial use. Phone sync is the weak spot: Obsidian Sync ($4/mo) or a Git/Syncthing setup. Choose Notion instead when notes must be edited live with clients or a team.
details: obsidian-git author calls mobile Git 'very unstable'; use Git on desktop only.

os_notes.macOS: Native app; iCloud folder or Obsidian Sync works.

verify.note: Shallow check: no neutrality, pricing or licence defect found; not re-fetched.
